claims.title: Predicting battery interface degradation from first principles
claims.statement: Lithium-ion and next-generation batteries fail through evolving interphases (SEI, cathode-electrolyte interfaces) whose chemistry and mechanics change with every cycle. No predictive model connects atomic-scale interfacial processes to cycle life across chemistries and operating conditions; degradation is managed empirically per design.

axis_texts.semantic: Connect atomic-scale interface chemistry to device-level lifetime prediction.
axis_texts.mechanism: interphase growth coupled to transport, mechanics, and side-reaction networks resists closed-form modeling
axis_texts.math_structure: reaction diffusion stochastic interfaces coupled multiscale models aging laws
axis_texts.problem_shape: atomistic to device-lifetime extrapolation; cross-chemistry generality
axis_texts.failure: empirical aging laws do not transfer across chemistries; atomistic simulations too slow for cycles

metadata.impact: EV range, grid storage, consumer electronics; safety

claims.title: Cloud feedback: the dominant uncertainty in climate sensitivity
claims.statement: How low marine clouds and tropical high clouds respond to warming remains the largest single source of spread in equilibrium climate sensitivity across models. Decades of observations and kilometer-scale simulations have narrowed but not resolved which feedback pathways dominate.

axis_texts.semantic: Determine how cloud cover and altitude distributions change with warming, and which mechanisms control it.
axis_texts.mechanism: competing positive and negative cloud feedbacks across regimes; subgrid turbulence-convection coupling
axis_texts.math_structure: radiative convective equilibrium large eddy simulation mixed layer budgets emergent constraint statistics
axis_texts.problem_shape: subgrid process to global sensitivity attribution among competing mechanisms
axis_texts.failure: global models parameterize clouds; LES covers limited domains and timescales

metadata.impact: carbon policy targets, adaptation planning, trillions in infrastructure

claims.title: Controlling edge turbulence and heat loads in fusion plasmas
claims.statement: Tokamak performance is limited by edge-localized modes and boundary turbulence that can dump destructive heat fluxes onto plasma-facing walls. Predictive control of the pedestal-edge region across scenarios remains unsolved despite major experimental programs.

axis_texts.semantic: Predict and control turbulent transport and transient heat loads at a magnetically confined plasma edge.
axis_texts.mechanism: pressure-gradient-driven instabilities interacting with shear flows and radiation
axis_texts.math_structure: gyrokinetics magnetohydrodynamics bifurcation control real-time estimation
axis_texts.problem_shape: microscale turbulence to macroscopic stability margins; prediction to actuation
axis_texts.failure: reduced models tuned per device; first-principles simulation far slower than real time

claims.title: First-principles predictive design of earth-abundant electrocatalysts
claims.statement: Designing catalysts for hydrogen evolution, CO2 reduction, or nitrogen fixation from computed properties alone fails reliably: activity descriptors (e.g., scaling relations) cap selectivity, and dynamic surface reconstruction under potential invalidates static pictures.

axis_texts.semantic: Go from computed material properties to a synthesizable catalyst with predicted activity and selectivity.
axis_texts.mechanism: descriptor-based screening hits scaling relation ceilings; operando surfaces differ from modeled ones
axis_texts.math_structure: dft scaling relations microkinetic models genetic algorithm search operando spectroscopy
axis_texts.problem_shape: static property to dynamic working-state prediction; screening to synthesis
axis_texts.failure: scaling relations force tradeoffs; reconstruction dynamics rarely captured

metadata.impact: green hydrogen, carbon utilization, fertilizer energy cost

claims.title: Skillful mid-term epidemic trajectory forecasting
claims.statement: Short-horizon epidemic forecasts have modest skill, but predicting trajectories beyond 4-8 weeks (where decisions matter most) has largely failed: behavior change, waning immunity, variant emergence, and reporting noise interact nonlinearly. Mechanistic models and statistical learning both underperform at this horizon.

axis_texts.semantic: Predict disease trajectory weeks ahead despite behavioral and immunological feedback.
axis_texts.mechanism: human behavior couples to incidence; pathogen evolution shifts the system mid-forecast
axis_texts.math_structure: branching processes renewal equations mechanistic compartmental models ensemble probabilistic forecasting
axis_texts.failure: models fit past waves but miss regime changes; data delays corrupt calibration

metadata.impact: hospital capacity, vaccination strategy, pandemic preparedness

claims.title: Raising crop photosynthetic efficiency beyond natural limits
claims.statement: C3 photosynthesis converts well under 5% of available solar energy into biomass, with known engineered inefficiencies (photorespiration, slow recovery from shade, insufficient Rubisco speed). Which intervention combination actually raises field yields - not just leaf-level rates - remains unpredictable from current physiology.

axis_texts.semantic: Translate known photosynthetic inefficiencies into reliable field-level yield gains.
axis_texts.mechanism: leaf-scale improvements wash out through canopy, source-sink, and stress interactions
axis_texts.math_structure: canopy radiation transfer enzyme kinetics whole-plant allocation quantitative genetics
axis_texts.problem_shape: molecular mechanism to agronomic trait; controlled environment to field
axis_texts.failure: leaf-level gains historically fail to propagate to yield; genotype-environment management interactions dominate

claims.title: Physics-based earthquake rupture and aftershock forecasting
claims.statement: Earthquake prediction beyond statistical recurrence catalogs remains elusive: fault stress states are unobservable directly, rupture initiation physics spans nanometers to kilometers, and proposed precursors (foreshock patterns, slow slip) lack reliable operational skill for mainshock timing and magnitude.

axis_texts.semantic: Forecast where and when ruptures will grow, from indirectly observed stress and fault geometry.
axis_texts.mechanism: stress accumulation and heterogeneous friction produce cascading ruptures sensitive to fine detail
axis_texts.math_structure: rate-and-state friction elastodynamics point process statistics Coulomb stress transfer
axis_texts.problem_shape: unobservable initial condition to probabilistic forecast; scale separation
axis_texts.failure: catalogs are statistical not physical; candidate precursors fail out-of-sample tests

claims.title: Predicting antibiotic resistance emergence before it spreads
claims.statement: Which mutations, gene acquisitions, and backgrounds will confer clinically relevant resistance - and in which species and settings they will emerge - cannot be predicted reliably. Surveillance detects resistance after establishment; prospective evolution remains beyond reach even for single drug-bug pairs.

axis_texts.semantic: Anticipate evolutionary paths to resistance before clinical detection.
axis_texts.mechanism: genotype-phenotype maps for resistance are context-dependent; fitness costs and compensation vary by environment
axis_texts.math_structure: fitness landscapes epistasis population genetics phylogenetic forecasting machine learning on sequences
axis_texts.problem_shape: forecast of contingent evolution; laboratory fitness to clinical success
axis_texts.failure: predictive models trained on known paths generalize poorly to novel mutations

metadata.impact: antimicrobial stewardship, drug development priorities, global health

claims.title: Microstructure-to-lifetime prediction for structural materials fatigue
claims.statement: Fatigue life of metals and composites varies by orders of magnitude due to microstructural detail (inclusions, grain orientation, defects) that scatter standard S-N curves. Predicting remaining life of an individual component from its measured microstructure is not currently possible, forcing conservative inspection schedules.

axis_texts.semantic: Predict a specific part's fatigue life from its measured microstructure instead of population statistics.
axis_texts.mechanism: crack initiation at extreme microstructural features dominates; extremes resist continuum modeling
axis_texts.math_structure: fracture mechanics crystal plasticity extreme value statistics defect distributions
axis_texts.problem_shape: extreme-event-dominated lifetime; specimen statistics to individual part
axis_texts.failure: models calibrated on averages miss tail events that determine failure

metadata.impact: aviation safety, infrastructure maintenance cost, wind turbines

claims.title: Reliable wildfire spread prediction in complex terrain under extreme weather
claims.statement: Fire spread models perform adequately in mild conditions but break down exactly when stakes are highest: wind-fire coupling, spotting, dry thunderstorms, and fuel heterogeneity make extreme-fire behavior chaotic. Evacuation decisions routinely rely on forecasts with unknown reliability at the critical moment.

axis_texts.semantic: Deliver trustworthy spread predictions precisely in the extreme regimes where fires become disasters.
axis_texts.mechanism: fire-atmosphere coupling creates self-organized extreme behavior; fuels data too coarse
axis_texts.math_structure: coupled fire atmosphere models cellular automata emulators probabilistic ensembles remote sensing assimilation
axis_texts.problem_shape: tail-risk prediction; coupling between fluid dynamics and combustion at landscape scale
axis_texts.failure: models validated on ordinary fires; extreme cases are rare, fast, and data-poor

metadata.impact: life safety, land management, insurance retreat from wildfire zones
